meta.title: AgentBridge — MCP Streamable HTTP Request & Streaming Sequence
meta.subtitle: JSON-RPC POST, Session Correlation, Streamable SSE Response & ActivityStore Auditing
meta.description: Trace of a request/response cycle over the remote MCP HTTP transport. Details HTTP POST transmission with injected authentication headers, server session identification (mcp-session-id), direct JSON vs streaming SSE response parsing, and ActivityStore auditing.
